on‑shift crew member / protagonist

Distinguishing features: small scar through right eyebrow; faint under-eye shadows suggesting fatigue.

Outfit: fitted zippered midweight technical coverall base layer under a low-bulk insulation vest in muted slate grey base with a single desaturated teal piping accent. Collar: small stand collar. Sleeves: long, cuffed at wrist. Pockets: two chest pockets, one thigh pocket, hook-and-loop tool patches. Belt: none, integrated waist cinch. Shoes: low utility boots, matte grey. Accessories: wrist dosimeter on non-dominant wrist, woven access-badge lanyard. Texture: A light, uniform paper/canvas grain overlay across the whole image — subtle enough to never read as noise or damage, present enough to avoid a flat vector-art look.
Palette: Flat, readable hues — avoid neon/oversaturated color. Favor 2-4 dominant hues plus neutrals per scene so the image reads instantly, even at thumbnail size.

- not hyper-realistic / photographic
- not childish preschool cartoon
- not generic corporate flat vector art
- no 3D-render look
- no anime/manga stylization
- exaggerated superhero or cinematic 'space opera' costume elements (capes, ornamental metal armor)
